acceptance_criteria: AC-1: seed.ts exports seedEmployeeFixtures() — creates employee user, mixed-type exam (5 question types), short-text exam with submitted session, saves employee JWT to .auth/employee.json
AC-2: playwright.live.config.ts splits into two projects — chromium-live-admin (full-walkthrough + admin-grading) and chromium-live-employee (employee-portal + exam-taking + exam-result)
AC-3: employee-portal.spec.ts contains 8 tests covering portal load, empty state, start modal open/cancel/confirm, continue CTA, view result CTA, my results page
AC-4: exam-taking.spec.ts contains 11 tests covering top bar/navigator, all 5 question input types, flag/unflag, navigator jump, finish→review screen, submit happy path, tab-switch modal
AC-5: exam-result.spec.ts contains 5 tests covering passed/failed/pending result screens, result detail page, back to portal navigation
AC-6: admin-grading.spec.ts contains 7 tests covering empty queue, session row+navigation, question display+nav, score validation, feedback textarea, submit all grades, pagination

AC-7: full-walkthrough.spec.ts has 5 targeted patches: (a) test 09 asserts Save Draft button; (b) test 13 hard-asserts From/To date inputs and Export CSV button; (c) test 16 removes /reports skip; (d) test 18 asserts Values Profile or pagination; (e) test 20 asserts heading on analytics page
AC-8: All 58 tests designed to pass against a live make dev stack
AC-9: TypeScript compiles cleanly with npx tsc --noEmit (exit 0)
AC-10: Screenshots taken at key interaction points using shot() helper in all new spec files
notes: No Go files changed. No migrations. Frontend-only. The e2e/ directory is outside tsconfig.json include scope (only covers src/) — Playwright handles e2e TypeScript transpilation itself. Direct type-check of e2e files with esnext module settings also passes (exit 0).
